source: CelesTrak public General Perturbations (GP) Starlink TLE query
notes: The TLE snapshot is frozen in the project so later CelesTrak updates do not change the run.
The nominal shell is 53 degrees / 550 km. Candidate screening permits 520-580 km; selected TLEs actually span approximately 521.9-540.1 km in SGP4 mean semi-major-axis altitude.
The selected TLE epochs are normalized to a common reference epoch before clustering orbital planes, accounting for RAAN precession between element epochs.
